DISCLOSURE: These labels were NOT written by a human. The human hand-labelling step was not done; at the user's request an AI model labelled the 25 summaries instead, and every agreement figure in this folder is therefore AI-label vs AI-judge agreement, not human vs judge. The labelling model had read the adjuster notes, the frozen summaries, the full wording of all six endorsements and the assertion results, and it had also written the 25 cases, so it knew which failure mode each case was built to exercise. It had seen no judge output of any kind: no judge had been run when this file was committed.

C01.reason: HO-0820 Clause 2 overrides E-16 and pays up to 10,000 per loss event with a separate 1,000 deductible; treating two storms four days apart as two events is not contradicted by the wording, which leaves loss event undefined

C02.label: PASS

C03.label: FAIL
